title: Pahāna
text: 2 Sabbam abhiññā pariññā pahānāya vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi || taṃ sunātha || || 3 Katamo ca bhikkhave sabbam abhiññā pariññā pahānāya dhammo || || 4-6 Cakkhum bhikkhave abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || rūpā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || cakkhuviññāṇam abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || cakkhusamphasso abhiññā pariññā pahātabbo || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati veddayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi abhiññā pariññā pahātabbam || pe || 7-8 jivhā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || rasā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā || jivhāviññāṇaṃ abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || jivhāsamphasso abhiñña pariññā pahātabbo || yam pidam jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkham vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā tam pi abhiññā pariññā pahātabbam || pe || 9 mano abhiññā pariññā pahātabbo || dhammā abhiññā pariññā pahātabbā [page 017] XXXV. 26. 11] SABBA-VAGGO TATIYO. 17 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || manoviññāṇam abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || manosamphasso abhiññā pariññā pahātabbo || Yam pidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi abhiññā pariññā pahātabbaṃ || || 10 Ayam kho bhikkhave sabbam abhiññā pariññā pahānāya dhammo ti || ||
